description.en: The ID of the alert contact.
The mobile number of the alert contact.

title.zh: 告警联系人发送手机号码验证

descriptions.zh: 收到手机号码验证短信后，请根据短信提示完成手机号验证。仅验证过的手机号可以在通知策略中使用电话的通知方式。
descriptions.en: After you receive the text message, verify the mobile number as prompted. Before you can specify a mobile phone number in a notification policy, you must verify the mobile phone number.
